response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial domain exposure (GISCollective, Green Map web GIS) and some low-latency, high-throughput backend work at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby using D with async I/O, fibers, and caching. However, the role's core requirement — modern C++ (or Rust) systems development — is largely unmet: his only professional C/C++ work was roughly seven months at National Instruments over a decade ago, with no Rust experience listed, and his recent five-plus years have been TypeScript/Node full-stack and product work. There is also no evidence of routing/navigation data pipelines, tiling, or large-scale distributed data-integrity systems. He could ramp up given his systems breadth and demonstrated willingness to learn new stacks, but he would start well behind candidates with current C++/Rust depth.
strengths: Real geospatial/GIS product experience (GISCollective, Green Map, FOSS4G talk)
Low-latency, high-volume microservices background (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, Linux/DevOps breadth
concerns: Modern C++ experience is minimal and over a decade old; no Rust
Recent years focused on TypeScript/Node full-stack, not systems programming
No experience with routing tiling, navigation guidance, or map data pipelines
